metadata.title: Tagong Nakham | Taro Shoots and Dried Fish
metadata.description:
Taro leaves and stalks are loaded with beta-carotene, calcium and contain vitamin C. Taro is also a very good source of fiber, is low in sodium and low in calories. 

Taro stalks can be prepared in many different ways and since this is a Garo cuisine and since I have already professed our love for dry fish, I am showing a recipe involving dried fishes and roselle sepals. 

This is a delicious, tangy, pungent and succulent dish that can be had as a side with steamed rice.
